card.name: Number or ordinal word after The in titles
card.fires_on: Mostly the word right after "The" in a title or list entry, such as Five, First, Second, complete or New. It also shows up on a few scattered words in reference lists.

modes.label: Title word after The
modes.description: An ordinal or number word, or adjective, that starts a title following "The".

modes.description: Words in book titles inside citations.

modes.label: Scattered clinical words
modes.description: Occasional single words in drug-label sentences.
modes.example: ine hydrochloride in a patient who is being<< treated>> with linezolid or intravenous meth
